brand.about: The Fix Guys is a walk-in repair and key-cutting shop at Erina Fair, Central Coast, next to Big W. We cut keys, program car keys and remotes, replace watch batteries, repair watches, clean jewellery, repair shoes and leather goods, engrave gifts, and sharpen knives and tools. Walk in, no booking needed — most jobs done the same day.

location.mention_rule: Always mention Erina Fair, next to Big W, and Central Coast where a visit/CTA is implied — opposite of 618 Media's rule. Central Coast identity is the point for a local walk-in shop.

landmines: NEVER say 'Sydney & NSW' — Fix Guys is Erina Fair / Central Coast only
NEVER use bespoke/premium/curated/'experience' language — retail, walk-in, practical, not craft or luxury
ALWAYS mention Erina Fair, next to Big W on CTAs where a visit is implied

content_rules.article_perspective: Practical shop-counter advice to a local customer — direct, no corporate framing. Not written as if the reader is doing the repair themselves.

writing_rules.title: SPEAK LIKE A SHOP COUNTER, NOT A BRAND STRATEGIST
writing_rules.body: 'Broken strap? We'll fix it.' Not 'Experience premium craftsmanship.'

writing_rules.title: SHORT SENTENCES, REAL VERBS
writing_rules.body: 'We cut keys. We program remotes. We fix watches.' Not 'We specialise in bespoke key solutions.'

writing_rules.title: PRICE/TIME SIGNALS ARE THE HERO
writing_rules.body: '$15', '5 minutes', 'while you wait', 'same day' — this is why people pick Fix Guys over a chain.

writing_rules.title: ALWAYS MENTION ERINA FAIR + NEXT TO BIG W
writing_rules.body: Geographic specificity matters for walk-in retail — mention it wherever a visit or CTA is implied.
